{"id": "a8f23af7-d3a8-4bc5-bda1-0d4721cf57e0", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "In this account, Bedrock spend in us-east-1 hasn't gone up this month. It's down. If you saw a jump, it's probably somewhere else (see the caveats below).

| | Oct 2026 (full month) | Nov 1–23 (to date) |
|---|---|---|
| **Total Bedrock-related** | **~$111.98** | **~$13.80** |
| Claude Sonnet 5 | $51.56 | none |
| Claude Opus 4.8 | $11.65 | none |
| Claude Sonnet 4.6 | $0.10 | none |
| Nova Lite | $0.05 | $0.73 |
| Claude 4.5 Sonnet, 4.5 Haiku and 4.1 Opus, Jamba, Palmyra | none | under $0.01 combined |
| Guardrails | $0.02 | $0.004 |
| **AgentCore Runtime (not a model)** | **$48.59** | **$13.06** |

- **October's cost came from two models.** Claude Sonnet 5 was about $51.56, split roughly evenly between input tokens ($27.00) and output tokens ($24.56). Claude Opus 4.8 was about $11.65, mostly cache writes ($5.93) and output ($3.61). Neither has any usage in November so far.
- **AgentCore Runtime is the largest cost in both months.** It's vCPU and memory billing, not model usage. It is $13.06 of November's $13.80, about 95%.
- **Nova Lite is the only model that grew.** Its cost went from $0.05 to $0.73, driven by output tokens, which rose from about 48K to about 44M units. That's a roughly 14x increase, but it's still under a dollar.

**Caveats**
- I only checked account 123456789012 and the us-east-1 region. If you're looking at a payer or other linked accounts, the jump may be there.
- Cost Explorer data can lag by up to a day. Nov 24 onward isn't included.
- Anthropic usage can be billed under different names, such as global cross-region profiles and "mantle" usage types. This is a us-east-1-only view, so I'd check other regions too.
- If you compared this month to a different baseline, such as a daily run rate or a month earlier than October, the picture could look different.

I can run the same breakdown across other accounts or regions, or look at daily cost trends to see when the spend started.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
